maroc.definition:
n a kingdom (constitutional monarchy) in northwestern Africa with a largely Muslim population; achieved independence from France in 1956
a of or relating to or characteristic of Morocco or its people
maroc.translation: n. （法）摩洛哥（北非国家, 等于Morocco）

marocain.definition: n. a dress crepe; similar to Canton crepe

marocains.definition:
plural of marocain
n. a dress crepe; similar to Canton crepe
marocains.translation: (marocain 的复数) n. 马罗坎平纹绉

marochetti's blisters.translation: [医] 马罗凯蒂氏水疱(狂犬病患者舌下的小水疱)

maronite.definition:
n. One of a body of nominal Christians, who speak the Arabic
   language, and reside on Mount Lebanon and in different parts of Syria.
   They take their name from one Maron of the 6th century.
maronite.translation: n. [宗]( 流行于黎巴嫩的天主教教派) 马龙派教徒

maronites.translation: n. 马龙派教徒（流行于黎巴嫩的天主教教派）

marons.translation: (maron 的复数)  [地名] [法国] 马龙

maroon.definition:
n. a person who is stranded (as on an island)
n. a dark purplish-red to dark brownish-red color
n. an exploding firework used as a warning signal
v. leave stranded or isolated with little hope of rescue
maroon.translation:
n. 逃亡黑人奴隶, 褐紫红色, 爆竹
a. 褐紫红色的
vt. 放逐到无人岛上, 使孤立
vi. 闲荡, 带帐篷旅行

marooned.definition:
v leave stranded or isolated with little hope of rescue
v leave stranded on a desert island without resources
s cut off or left behind
marooned.translation: a. 被围困的；孤立无援的；无法脱身的

marooner.definition: s of dark brownish to purplish red
marooner.translation: n. 海盗, 肆无忌惮的冒险家

marooning.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Maroon
marooning.translation: vt. 把…放逐到孤岛（maroon的现在分词形式）

maroons.definition:
n a person who is stranded (as on an island)
n a dark purplish-red to dark brownish-red color
n an exploding firework used as a warning signal
v leave stranded or isolated with little hope of rescue
v leave stranded on a desert island without resources
maroons.translation:
n. 逃亡黑奴（maroon的复数形式）
vt. 把…放逐到孤岛（maroon的第三人称单数形式）

maroquin.translation: n. 搓纹革, 植鞣山羊搓纹革, 摩洛哥革

maror.translation: [单复同] n.苦菜(犹太人在逾越节时食用,以象征以色列人昔时遭受埃及人压迫之苦)

marostica.translation: [地名] [意大利] 马罗斯蒂卡

marot.translation: [地名] [巴基斯坦、印度] 默罗德

marouflage.translation: 贴画法(用胶粘剂将油画贴到墙上的方法)
